title.rendered: Greater Is He That Is in You: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: You have overcome, past tense, settled, done. Not because of your strength but because of the One in you. Greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world. Act accordingly.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Thursday, May 7, 2026

📖 Today’s Scripture

“You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.”
1 John 4:4 (NIV) | ESV

📝 Today’s Message

John does not say you will overcome eventually, if you try hard enough, with the right spiritual disciplines in place. He says you have overcome, past tense, settled, done. Because the One in you is greater.

Greater. Not slightly stronger. Not marginally more powerful. Greater. The One who spoke the universe into existence, who raised Jesus from the dead, who holds all things together by the word of His power, He lives in you. Every opposing force, every spiritual darkness, every scheme of the enemy operates in a lesser dimension than the God who is in you.

This is the confidence of the believer, not confidence in yourself, your strength, or your spiritual track record. Confidence in Him who is in you. Romans 8:31 asks: if God is for us, who can be against us? Not who is against us, there may be plenty who are. But who can stand against us, when the Greater One lives within us?

When you feel surrounded, outgunned, outmanoeuvred, the equation has not changed. Greater is He that is in you. The circumstances do not alter that reality. The feeling of being overwhelmed does not alter it. The size of the opposition does not alter it. You carry the Greater One. Act accordingly.

🙏 Prayer

Father, I am reminded today that I carry You, and You are greater than anything I face. I refuse to be intimidated by what I see in the natural because I know what is true in the Spirit. Greater is He that is in me. I walk in that confidence today, not in my own strength but in Yours. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🗣️ Declaration

Greater is He that is in me than he that is in the world. I have overcome, not because of my strength but because of the One who lives in me. I am not intimidated by opposition, circumstances or spiritual pressure. I carry the Greater One and I walk in that authority today. The victory is already settled.
